page.title: Distribution of {{year}}
page.description: The powder and weapons days, each comparsa's slot and the pickup proxies.
page.loadFailed: The distribution could not be loaded.
page.staleFailed: The distribution could not be refreshed: what you see may be outdated.

noCurrent.title: There is no edition in progress
noCurrent.body: The distribution belongs to an edition. Open the editions to choose one.

notInProgress.DRAFT: The edition is a draft: the distribution days are planned once it is in progress.
notInProgress.CLOSED: The edition is not in progress: the distribution days and slots can no longer be changed.

day.deleteDescription: Its slots are removed too. The pickup proxies are kept.

slots.title: Slots

caption.POWDER: Slots of the powder distribution day
caption.WEAPONS: Slots of the weapons distribution day

slots.hint: One start time per comparsa. Leave it empty for no slot; comparsas may share a time.

list.title: Distribution list
list.numbering: The numbers are worked out on each download: a list downloaded after changes may number differently.

notValidated.title: Orders not validated
notValidated.body_one: This comparsa's order is not validated and is not on the list:
notValidated.body_other: These {{count}} comparsas' orders are not validated and are not on the list:

proxies.title: Pickup proxies
proxies.description: Exceptionally, an arquebusier who cannot attend authorises another arquebusier of the same order to collect for them.
proxies.caption: List of proxies
proxies.problemHint: A proxy with a problem is left out of the list and has no form. Remove it and register it again if needed.
proxies.holderHint: Who cannot attend: entries with something of this type to collect and no proxy for it.
proxies.proxyHint: Another arquebusier of the same order, with an active weapons license on the day.
proxies.noHolders: Nobody in this order can have a proxy of this type.

ineligible.licenseInvalid: no active weapons license on the pickup day

proxies.reasonNote: The reason is not stored: it is written by hand on the printed form, which both people sign.
proxies.removeDescription: {{proxy}} will no longer collect for {{holder}}. A form already printed is no longer valid.
proxies.readOnly: The edition is not in progress: proxies can no longer be added or removed. Their forms can still be printed.
proxies.peopleFailed: The order's entries could not be loaded.
proxies.readOnlyDraft: The edition is a draft: proxies are registered once it is in progress.
proxies.comparsasFailed: The comparsas could not be loaded: proxies cannot be filtered or added.

distribution.notFound: The distribution day no longer exists. The page has been refreshed.
distribution.alreadyPlanned: This day is already planned. The page has been refreshed.
distribution.editionNotInProgress: The edition is not in progress: the distribution can no longer be changed.
distribution.modified: Someone else changed this day. The page has been refreshed: check it and try again.
distribution.busy: Someone else is changing these proxies. Try again in a moment.
distribution.auditUnavailable: The change could not be recorded, so it was not saved. Try again in a few minutes.

proxies.notFound: The proxy no longer exists. The page has been refreshed.
proxies.alreadyAuthorised: The holder already has a proxy of this type.
proxies.proxyAbsent: The proxy has a proxy of this type themselves, so they cannot collect for others.
proxies.holderIsProxy: The holder collects for others of this type, so they cannot have a proxy.

errors.tooMany: You have made too many requests in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Try again.

fields.time: Write a complete time: hours and minutes.
fields.date: Write a complete date: day, month and year.
fields.outOfEdition: Must be in the edition's year and not after the festival.
fields.notInOrder: Must be another entry of the same order.
fields.sameAsHolder: Must be someone other than the holder.
fields.nothingToCollect: The holder has nothing of this type to collect.
fields.licenseInvalid: Has no active weapons license on the day.
